subject.title: feat(android): add Wear OS app MVP

question: Should OpenClaw accept and maintain a first-party Wear OS companion app in the Android tree once the technical blockers are fixed?
rationale: This adds a new shipped app plus gateway auth, phone-proxy, CI, release, and support obligations, so automation can identify blockers but cannot choose the product ownership direction.

options.title: Sponsor first-party Wear OS
options.body: Keep this PR or an adopted successor open, require the blockers and runtime proof, then review it as a maintained Android surface.

options.title: Move outside core
options.body: If maintainers do not want to own Wear OS in-tree, close this PR after directing the work to a separately maintained companion app path.

recommendation.title: Sponsor first-party Wear OS
recommendation.body: Keep this PR or an adopted successor open, require the blockers and runtime proof, then review it as a maintained Android surface.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus is the current assignee and has already touched the PR branch's Wear initialization path.
